harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the boot-persistent SysV service inventory-worker on node1. It runs under the dedicated non-login inventorysvc account. Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remain unchanged, and the service recovered successfully after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account with /nonexistent home and /bin/false shell.
Installed /etc/init.d/inventory-worker with start, stop, restart, and status operations.
Enabled inventory-worker in SysV runlevels 2–5 and started it.
Verified a managed service restart and UID/GID ownership.
Restarted node1 safely and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the service, account, worker binary, OS release, and kernel after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Run the worker as managed service inventory-worker
evidence.summary: Shows the SysV service definition, enabled boot links, successful status/restart, and the exact worker command line.
Shows creation of the dedicated non-login system account and the live worker running with inventorysvc UID 105 and GID 112.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, node1 reports Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.

Baseline boot ID was 10de8ec5-9cce-4c68-b857-73fdab226881; the reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is ecbc0cc4-1d63-48ef-8f2d-a6549559ea09; post-reboot proof shows inventory-worker running as inventorysvc with unchanged worker checksum and persistent boot registration.
